title: Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Testing zero-shot and few-shot diagnostic accuracy on African tropical clinical case studies and evaluating recommendations for tropical agro-ecology to measure the failure of Western-centric baselines in African contexts.
Measuring downstream model performance on African NLP and linguistic benchmarks, including AfriSenti, AfriQA, and low-resource African machine translation tasks.

Evaluating models on African medical diagnostic reasoning and smallholder agricultural practices to demonstrate how models default to Western institutional protocols and temperate industrial monoculture recommendations.
